text:
devon: deploy-bot just flagged a regression in canary, low volume but consistent p95 jump for embeddings.
deploy-bot: Automated check: p95 increased 42% vs baseline, error rate +0.6%, suggested action: AUTO-REVERT in 10m unless acknowledged.
sara: I saw that in dashboards, but release notes mention schema migration for embeddings; could be related.
alex: Is this the release that included `kv-cache` flag?
mike: Yes — we toggled `kv-cache=v2` and bumped model to rwd-emb-v3.
devon: We need decision: allow auto-revert or manual rollback and pin?
ops-oncall: Change window closes in 35m; auto-revert would start 10m from now. If we revert now, customers on Dedicated get a config drift.
sara: I'd prefer manual to coordinate customer comms. we need to pin to previous model and update release notes.
alex: Agreed. Manual rollback steps: 1) Pause auto-revert: `deploy-bot ack --thread 7022223333 --no-auto` 2) Run revert command on canary: `redwoodctl rollout revert --service embeddings --to rwd-emb-v2 --force-canary` 3) Pin for 24h: `redwoodctl pin --service embeddings --version rwd-emb-v2 --ttl 24h` 4) Notify customers + ops-oncall to open postmortem ticket.
devon: I'll ack the bot now.
devon: deploy-bot ack --no-auto (sent) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Auto-revert suppressed by human ack.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary revert command queued in 2m.
mike: I'll run the canary revert and monitor p95.
sara: I'll draft a short release-note addendum: "Reverted rwd-emb-v3 for canary due to p95 regression; investigating kv-cache change."
devon: Ops, please prepare customer-facing note for Dedicated customers and list exact affected pool ids.
ops-oncall: Got it, collecting pool IDs, will post in #customer-success once ready.
alex: After canary looks stable, we can rollforward with a variant that keeps old kv-cache + model v3 later.
devon: Good. tagging @everyone impacted. :eyes:
mike: revert started, logs: ```starting rollout revert canary->stable step1/3```
mike: monitoring p95, will update in 5m.
sara: thx — will update release notes + changelog.
alex: postmortem ticket: INF-4721 created.
devon: closing thread when we confirm metrics. end.
